report.summary: Landed one coherent capability milestone: `set_clipboard`, the write half of the clipboard trio. Jarvis can now copy a chosen piece of text to the device clipboard - 'copy this to the clipboard' / 'put this on my clipboard' / 'copy this address so I can paste it' - including a value captured by an earlier read step via a `{{name}}` variable. It is opt-in (off by default: a write clobbers whatever the user had copied), gated both in the executor and the planner prompt, service-free (works without a bound a11y service), and honest (the writer reads the clip back and reports success only when the clipboard actually holds the text).
